title: 第四章 入城第五章 分别第六章 洪元帅
content_zh:
李言听了这些便马车前行中，低头沉思了起来，过了一会后这才看向了一脸担心的李玉、李山。
“也没什么的，若前面真像国新叔说那样，这几次都挡住了敌兵，后面即使有战事，暂时应该也是无大仗。
经历过前几场攻城，他们都没有拿下县城，死伤如此之多，敌兵对洪元帅肯定已是忌惮。
定也知道除非这里换了主将方也许有机会攻入，或有天灾之类的祸事或可乘机攻破。
但是这种事情想来洪元帅及手下谋士都已想到，那些可都是久经沙场阵仗之的大人，所以应该不会轻易再有大军压进了。”
听到这些，李国新不由惊讶地望向李言。
这些事的确像李言所说，近一年左右孟国都未再向青山隘出过大军了，只是偶尔还是有小股骑兵骚扰袭击罢了。
“你是如何有这般想法的？”
李国新不由惊疑问道。
“国新叔，这个和我们入山围猎有时差不多，像我们被群狼围攻，哪一次不是你奋勇只身挡在前面，带领大伙挡住它们几次进攻。
而他们今天轮守的这北门，来人一般都是所辖之地的村民或皇朝内跑商之人。
“是是是！”
李言见对方看向自己，也立即长身跳下马车，躬身行礼。
“哦，原来是你！
你这小娃先前说的话倒有几份见解，参军倒也算是合适，我们洪元帅现在对有谋才之人甚是看重，毕竟有力气的兵卒还是多些的。”
毕竟李言从身架上看来只有十六、七岁，身着粗布衣衫，却非大富大贵的公子，若是那些公子哥，他倒也不觉得奇怪。
“刘头，你怎么对一个乡下小子如此客气了？”
毕竟这些出身之人，家中长辈之口会经常说道这些事件，听过后出来学舌一番到也不稀奇的。
这时，又一个军卒奇怪地问道。
多杀一些狼崽子后，那些群狼就开始变的害怕起来，后面就会自行退去，当然就是怕了国新叔你了。

这时旁边那军卒接口道。
看着他们一行入得城内，旁边一小卒向刘成勇奇怪问道。
便不再说此事。
而季军师最近两年开始，在每次征兵入伍时，他都会前往校场，对报名的兵卒都亲自测试一番，尤其是对读过书的……”
李国新接过路引入后放入怀中，道了声谢，招呼李言三人赶紧上车后，驾车开始缓缓向城门洞走去。
毕竟每次征兵入伍，虽然报名人数有限，但自从征兵有了提前给出补贴费用后，每次也是有几十到几百人前来的。
不过听说，去年年初季大人在中军大营一小队里选到了一名合适的徒弟，只是知道此人的倒是不多。
他站在两排兵中间之前的位置，正好挡住城门入口，想来应是领队头目了。
另一名兵卒看了左右此刻无闲人后，也是压低声音说道。
刘成勇看了他一眼，淡淡的说。
说着拿出早已准备好的路引双手递了过去，并接着说。
“我叫刘成勇，是战丙营三队队长，以后我们说不得会有交道要打的。”
但是此时他也是心中有事，便也不再多想，急匆匆赶车进城而去。
当他听到参军入伍几字后，笑道。
李国新听了后，不由伸出一只手拍了拍车辕，哈哈一笑。
“军爷，只有他一人参军入伍，其他二人皆做学徒的。”
“这位小兄弟，说得极是，我们洪元帅和季军师都是当世猛将与大才之人。
content_en:
After hearing this, Li Yan drove the carriage forward, lowered his head and began to think deeply. After a while, he looked at Li Yu and Li Shan who looked worried.
"It's nothing. If it's like Uncle Guo Xin said, and we have blocked the enemy soldiers these few times, even if there is a war later, there should be no major battles for the time being.
After experiencing the previous sieges, they failed to capture the county seat. With so many casualties, the enemy soldiers must have been afraid of Marshal Hong.
Ding also knows that unless the main general here is changed, there may be a chance to invade, or there may be a disaster such as a natural disaster that may take the opportunity to attack.
However, Marshal Hong and his counselors have already thought about this kind of thing. They are all adults who have been on the battlefield for a long time, so they should not be easily pressed in by another large army. "
Hearing this, Li Guoxin couldn't help but look at Li Yan in surprise.
These things are indeed as Li Yan said. In the past year or so, Meng has not sent a large army to Qingshan Pass, but occasionally there are still small groups of cavalry to harass and attack.
"How did you come up with such an idea?"
Li Guoxin couldn't help but asked in surprise.
"Uncle Guoxin, this is similar to when we go hunting in the mountains. For example, when we are besieged by a pack of wolves, there is no time when you bravely stood in front alone and led everyone to block their attacks several times.
As for the north gate they were guarding today, the visitors were usually villagers from the area under their jurisdiction or businessmen from the dynasty.
“Yes yes yes! "
When Li Yan saw the other party looking at him, he immediately jumped out of the carriage and bowed to salute.
"Oh, it's you!
What you little kid said earlier seems to have some insights. It is appropriate to join the army. Our Marshal Hong now attaches great importance to people who are resourceful and talented. After all, there are still more capable soldiers. "
After all, Li Yan looked like he was only sixteen or seventeen years old, and he was wearing coarse clothes, but he was not a wealthy young man. If he was one of those young men, he wouldn't be surprised.
"Liu Tou, why are you so polite to a country boy? "
After all, people from these backgrounds and elders in the family often talk about these events, and it is not unusual for them to imitate them after hearing them.
At this time, another soldier asked strangely.
After killing more wolf cubs, the wolves will start to become afraid and will retreat on their own. Of course, they are afraid of you, Uncle Guoxin.
At this time, the soldier next to him said.
Watching them enter the city, a soldier next to him asked Liu Chengyong strangely.
He said no more about it.
In the past two years, the third army division has been going to the school field every time he recruits soldiers to personally test the registered soldiers, especially those who have read..."
Li Guoxin took the road and introduced it into his arms. He thanked him, told Li Yan and the others to get in the car quickly, and started to drive slowly towards the city gate.
After all, each time the army is recruited, although the number of applicants is limited, since the recruitment fees are subsidized in advance, dozens to hundreds of people come every time.
However, I heard that Master Ji selected a suitable apprentice from a small team of the Chinese Army Camp at the beginning of last year, but not many people knew about this person.
He stood in front of the two rows of soldiers, just blocking the entrance to the city gate. He must be the leader of the group.
Another soldier also lowered his voice and said after seeing that no one was idle at the moment.
Liu Chengyong glanced at him and said calmly.
As he spoke, he took out the road guide that he had prepared and handed it over with both hands, and continued.
"My name is Liu Chengyong, and I am the captain of the third team of Zhan Bing Battalion. We must not have any dealings with each other in the future."
But at this time, he also had something on his mind, so he stopped thinking about it and hurried into the city.
When he heard the words "join the army", he smiled.
After hearing this, Li Guoxin couldn't help but stretched out a hand and patted the shaft of the car, laughing.
"Master Jun, he is the only one who joined the army, and the other two are apprentices."
"This little brother is absolutely right. Marshal Hong and Master Ji are both powerful generals and talented people in this world.
